const PILL = {
  display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center',
  minHeight: '52px', padding: '0 20px', borderRadius: '4px',
  textDecoration: 'none', border: '1px solid #E9E2D3'
};

class Component extends DCLogic {
  state = { key: 'above50' };

  renderVals() {
    const active = DATA.find(d => d.key === this.state.key) || DATA[3];
    const bands = DATA.map(d => {
      const on = d.key === active.key;
      return {
        label: d.label,
        href: d.href,
        current: on ? 'page' : null,
        countLabel: d.places.length + ' places',
        go: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); this.setState({ key: d.key }); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); },
        style: Object.assign({}, PILL, on
          ? { background: '#5A4420', borderColor: '#5A4420', color: '#FFFFFF' }
          : { background: '#FFFFFF', color: '#514A3F' })
      };
    });
    const n = active.places.length;
    const known = active.places.filter(p => p.distance !== TBC).length;
    return {
      bands,
      crumb: active.crumb,
      h1: active.h1,
      standfirst: active.standfirst,
      listHeading: active.heading,
      listCount: known === n
        ? n + ' places, in the order they appear on the live page.'
        : n + ' places, in the order they appear on the live page. ' + (n - known) + ' distances are not stated on the live page and are marked [TO CONFIRM].',
      places: active.places.map(p => ({
        name: p.name,
        distance: p.distance,
        img: p.img,
        alt: p.alt || '',
        summary: p.summary,
        goodFor: p.goodFor
      }))
    };
  }
}
